explanation: In Lehr's rule δ is the absolute difference: a 10% relative lift on a 4% baseline is 0.04 × 0.10 = 0.004. With δ = 0.10 the formula divides by 0.01 instead of 0.000016, so it returns about 61 users per variant instead of about 38,400. Using a relative MDE as if it were absolute is the common mistake.
